The jizō come in the night

cues.text: Long ago, a poor old man and his wife
It was the last day of the year,
and they had no rice for New Year.
All they had were five straw hats they had woven.
The old man carried the hats to the market in town.
But it snowed all day, and nobody bought a single one.
On the way home, he passed six stone jizō
He brushed off the snow and gave each one a hat.
There were only five. To the last, he gave his own cloth.
That night, there were footsteps in the snow.
Six jizō were coming to the house, pulling a heavy sled.
They left it at the door, and went quietly away.
In the morning, they found rice and mochi
